title: One Bean for Each of Us – A Week on the Windowsill | Bedtime Read-Aloud
description:
Every morning, Rafi and his cousin Nila sing to the beans they planted on the windowsill. When Nila spots a green hook in her pot, Rafi draws what he can see in his own pot: soil and one little white pebble. Their notebook helps them notice how much can change in a week, even when the two beans grow at different speeds.

With a simple refrain and small discoveries to look forward to, this Giggle & Snooze story makes a gentle bedtime read-aloud for ages 4–7. Children can join in with “Up, up, little bean!” and settle into the cousins’ easy rhythm of looking, drawing, and waiting.
